_meta.description: Top-level IP2025 .par default files (parameter defaults, lithology tables, Gassmann rock library, Monte-Carlo uncertainty defaults, fracture-gradient coefficients, formation-testing mnemonic catalog, image-convolution kernels).

Poisson_Ratio_Lithologies.purpose: Default Poisson's ratio per lithology; used by Daines fracture-gradient method (PPFG).

Cap_Pressure_Fluid_Prop_Defaults.purpose: Default contact-angle & interfacial-tension per lab/reservoir cap-pressure system (Mercury Injection, Centrifuge, Porous Plate, Water-Oil, Water-Gas). Used to convert lab Pc to reservoir Pc.

FluidSub_Default_Rocks.purpose: Gassmann fluid-substitution mineral/rock library: dry-frame bulk & shear moduli, matrix DTc, and Greenberg-Castagna Vs regression coefficients (a,b,c) per mineral. Reference: Rock Physics Handbook (Mavko-Mukerji-Dvorkin) 2003, CHS 2007.

Fract_Grad_Coeff.purpose: Depth-below-mudline polynomial coefficients (a+bD+cD^2+dD^3+eD^4). Eaton section: Poisson's ratio vs depth (Gulf Coast, Deep Water). Matthews-Kelly section: matrix-stress coefficient vs depth (S TX / LA Gulf Coast). Depth D in feet below mudline.

MonteCarloDefaults.purpose: Default Monte-Carlo uncertainty shifts per module parameter. Shift types: Linear / % / Rec(iprocal). Distribution: Gaussian/Triangular/Square. Low & High are +/- shift magnitudes in parameter units (or % if shift='%'). Sections map to IP modules (ClayVol, PhiSw, MinSolve=Multimin, Cutoff, etc.).

Xplot.raw: Av Phi Res          -999 -999 Vcl Cut Res/Pay     -999  -999    0

FT_Tools.purpose: Formation-testing (pressure/sampling) tool mnemonic mapping catalog: per vendor tool, maps native curve mnemonics to IP curve names/types. Reference catalog only.

Image_Analysis_Convolutions.purpose: Image-processing convolution kernels for borehole-image tools (rows x cols matrix + divisor). Standard DSP kernels (Gaussian, Sobel, Prewitt, Kirsch, Laplacian-of-Gaussian).
